turns.userText:
Repair the offline EPIC collective collector in `/workspace/project`.
It must consume finite four-port packet captures and return exact wire and buffer certificates.
The supplied C codec and switch re

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && echo '--- LIMITS ---' && cat LIMITS.md && echo '--- PROTOCOL ---' && cat PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sort && echo '--- solver.py ---' && sed -n '1,240p' solver.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo '--- README ---' && cat README.md && echo '--- Makefile ---' && cat Makefile && echo '--- wire.py ---' && cat wire.py && echo '---

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo '--- epic_clean.h ---' && cat include/epic_clean.h && echo '--- offline_api.h ---' && cat include/offline_api.h && echo '--- offli

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo '--- roce_packet.c ---' && sed -n '1,260p' src/roce_packet.c && echo '--- rest ---' && sed -n '261,520p' src/roce_packet.c

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo '--- star4_switch.c part1 ---' && sed -n '1,300p' src/star4_switch.c && echo '--- part2 ---' && sed -n '301,620p' src/star4_switch

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat examples.json && echo '--- public_check ---' && sed -n '1,300p' public_check.py && echo '--- instruction ---' && cat instruction.md && echo

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && gcc --version | head -1; python3 --version; make -C . BUILD=/workspace/tmp/build -j2 >/tmp/make.log 2>&1; echo make=$?; cat /tmp/make.l

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && grep -n '^bool epic_parse_roce\|^static size_t build_roce_base' src/roce_packet.c

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 public_check.py project/solver.py; echo status=$?

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && time python3 project/solver.py </tmp/bench.json >/tmp/bench.out; echo status=$?; ls -lh /tmp/bench.out; head -c 300 /tmp/bench.out

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && du -ah . | sort -h | tail -20 && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && find . -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort && find . -type d -printf '%p\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 public_check.py project/solver.py; echo status=$?

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%n %p %s\n' | sort && find . -type l -print

records.name: bash
records.summary: which valgrind || true; ls /usr/bin | grep -E 'valgrind|clang' | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf tmp/roproject tmp/rotmp && cp -a project tmp/roproject && mkdir -p tmp/rotmp && chmod -R a-w tmp/roproject && TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp/rotm

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && grep -n '^bool epic_parse_roce\|^static uint16_t load_be16_unaligned\|^static uint32_t load_be32_unaligned\|^static bool ipv4_header_ch

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && printf '{' | python3 project/solver.py; echo; printf '{"cases": []}' | python3 project/solver.py; echo; python3 - <<'PY' | python3 project/solv

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_compare.py >/tmp/fuzz4.out 2>/tmp/fuzz4.err; echo status=$?; tail -5 /tmp/fuzz4.err; tail -3 /tmp/fuzz4.out

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && python3 -m py_compile solver.py wire.py request.py && echo pyok && sed -n '1,240p' solver.py && echo '--- Makefile ---' && cat Makefile

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && find . -maxdepth 3 -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && echo '--- sizes ---' && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf tmp/* project/__pycache__ && python3 public_check.py project/solver.py; status=$?; echo public_status=$status; rm -rf project/__pycache_

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf tmp/* project/__pycache__ && ls -la tmp && find project -name '__pycache__' -o -name build
